topic.title: Rule 2.4.b: does a model trained on MassSpecGym (MIT) count as redistribution of competition data?
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hello organisers,

Rule 2.4.b prohibits redistributing Competition Data to non-participants. Could you confirm in writing whether the following are permitted in a prize-eligible, open-source (MIT) winning solution:

A model or retrieval library trained on MassSpecGym (MIT, Bushuiev et al. 2024) and on public spectral libraries with licences CC BY 4.0 or CC0 (MoNA, Zenodo 11193898 "GNPS cleaned", record-level MassBank records under CC BY 4.0), with attribution. A model trained on the Competition Data (train.parquet) and released with the solution. We are not redistributing the Competition Data or the test set; the question is whether the trained artefacts and the rebuilt public-source library fall within the rules.

Thank you.
